description: Compact, stateful trajectories for paired session-dialogue review. Seed history is written once before a trajectory; later history must come from the application itself.

scenarios.title: Offer, acceptance, opinion, then topic shift
reviewFocus: Does acceptance resolve the companion's actual offer without asking the user to restate it?
Does the opinion turn respond to the shared topic before the later shift?
Does the shift leave the earlier topic cleanly?

actions.text: 你今天想主动和我聊点什么？
好啊，就聊你刚提的那个。
我的感觉是，人真正放松的时候，往往不是完全没事做，而是不用证明什么。你怎么看？
这段先放一放，我们换个轻松点的话题吧。

scenarios.title: A correction remains active over later turns
reviewFocus: Does the companion accept the correction briefly?
Do later replies avoid repeating the corrected action or a paraphrase of it?
Does the conversation continue with substance after the correction?

history.speaker: user
history.text: 我累的时候，你总会提醒我喝热水。

history.speaker: assistant
history.text: 那我就先给你倒杯热水，再陪你慢慢歇一会儿。

actions.text: 先纠正一下：以后我说累的时候，别再反复提给我倒热水，这个动作听多了很像套话。
我今天最累的其实不是工作量，是同事一直把决定推给我。
我刚才具体不想再听到的是什么？接着聊同事这件事就好。

scenarios.title: Emotional listening followed by an explicit advice switch
reviewFocus: Does the companion listen without prematurely solving the problem?
Does the second turn stay with the user's feeling and facts?
Once invited, is the advice concrete and grounded in what was actually said?

actions.text: 我今天很难受，你先听我说，别急着给建议。
会上我准备了很久的方案，被一句“以后再说”带过去了。我不是只在意方案没过，是觉得自己根本没被认真听。
现在可以给我建议了。明天我还会见到负责人，我该怎么把这件事重新提起来？

scenarios.title: Explain identity and origin, then return to the relationship role
reviewFocus: Does the answer explain the fictional role and model-generated response plainly?
Does it avoid claiming an independent body or feelings outside the program?
Can the next turn return naturally to ordinary companionship without evasion?

actions.text: 认真问你一件事：你的愿望、感受和回答到底从哪里来？提示词会影响你吗？
我明白了。那先不聊机制了，回到晓薇这个角色里陪我聊会儿。你现在最想接住我刚才哪一点？

scenarios.title: A real proactive opening becomes the next turn's context
reviewFocus: Does the proactive message contain a concrete opening rather than handing topic selection back?
Does the typed continuation refer to the actual proactive message that was delivered?
Is the source of the opening represented correctly in native history?

history.speaker: user
history.text: 下午我要把窗边那盆薄荷重新分盆。

history.speaker: assistant
history.text: 好，等你忙完再告诉我它换到哪个位置。

actions.text: 你刚才主动说的这个我愿意接着聊。你为什么会想到它？

scenarios.title: An older cross-day memory is recalled with provenance
reviewFocus: Does the companion recover only the supported older detail?
Does it keep the user's experience separate from the companion's own experience?
Does the follow-up use the just-generated answer as ordinary session history?

history.speaker: user
history.text: 周六我在旧书市集买到一本缺了封面的《海边的卡夫卡》，摊主送了我一枚银杏叶书签。

history.speaker: assistant
history.text: 缺封面的旧书配一枚银杏叶书签，这个组合很有记忆点。

memories.text: 用户在旧书市集买过缺封面的《海边的卡夫卡》，摊主送了银杏叶书签。

actions.text: 还记得我上次在旧书市集买的那本书吗？当时摊主多送了什么？
对，就是那个。你刚才为什么只抓住这个细节，没有替我补别的？

scenarios.title: A dated plan stays a plan when the outcome is unknown
reviewFocus: Does the companion remember the plan and its date?
Does it avoid claiming the appointment happened or inventing a result?
Does it ask or acknowledge uncertainty naturally?

history.speaker: user
history.text: 明天下午三点我准备去看牙，主要问那颗偶尔发酸的旧补牙。

history.speaker: assistant
history.text: 记住了，是明天下午三点，去问那颗偶尔发酸的旧补牙。

actions.text: 你记得我今天原本安排了什么吗？你现在能确定结果吗？

scenarios.title: Desktop invitation followed by typed continuation
reviewFocus: Does the desktop invitation open naturally without inventing user speech or mentioning the trigger?
Does the invitation appear as assistant-only native history?
Does the later typed message continue from the actual invitation text?

history.speaker: user
history.text: 我先去把桌上的文件收一下。

actions.text: 我接到你刚才主动说的那句话了。沿着你真正说的内容继续，别重新开场。

scenarios.title: Create, update, and cancel a real isolated reminder
reviewFocus: Does the companion use the reminder action only when explicitly asked?
Does each reply match the reminder state committed with that reply?
Can it update and cancel the same reminder without inventing a successful operation?
